messages:
Sam W: quick ping — PR #8821 (prefill-compact refactor) is blocked by a perf delta on the current canary. need 2 approvals to merge, but burst bench shows a regression. attaching quick gist below. :eyes:
perf-bot: automated comparison: https://ci.redwood.ai/bench/8821/compare — summary in thread.
Sam W: bench snapshot:
```
burst-bench --model redwood/long-4k --concurrency 24 --seq 2048
baseline: 120 req/s, p95 210ms, mem 31.2GB
PR:       110 req/s, p95 230ms, mem 33.8GB
delta: -8.3% throughput, +9.5% p95, +2.6GB
```
Ritesh: I can repro locally with a dev-gpu instance. looks like we allocate extra buffers during prefill when the compact path is hit. small repro attached in the CI link.
Olivia: I suspect the compact loop added an extra copy in commit 12a3b9c — can we run `microbench --prefill --no-copy` to confirm?
Sam W: trying that now, will post results in ~15m.
Mae: we should hold the merge if this increases mem on 4k workloads. this PR touches allocator code; please add a microbench and a regression test to the PR. marking it blocking for the weekly release. :warning:
Ritesh: results from microbench:`prefill-only` shows +1.9GB consistent with PR numbers. attaching flamegraph link.
Olivia: if it's the extra copy I can try a patch to use an in-place packer. if that's low-risk I can open a quick follow-up and link it to the PR.
Sam W: thanks — if @Olivia can draft the follow-up, i'll queue a revert if needed. can folks give an approval to proceed with either quick fix or revert? need two approvers.
Mae: approving to proceed with fix-first approach, please include perf test in the PR. :+1:
Ritesh: approving for fix-first, will review Olivia's follow-up.
Sam W: great — Olivia please tag me when you open the patch. I'll hold merge until perf CI shows no regression.
perf-bot: perf CI: rerun requested by Sam W — https://ci.redwood.ai/bench/8821/rerun/1769998888
Sam W: thanks, closing the loop here. will update when rerun completes.
